subject: Linguistics
title: Hyponymy and Hypernymy
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Hyponymy and Hypernymy.

hook.text: A robin is a bird. A bird is an animal. These 'is-a' links organize your mental dictionary.

buildup.text: 'Robin' is a hyponym of 'bird'; 'bird' is a hypernym of 'robin.'

discovery.text: Hyponymy creates a taxonomy—a tree of categories from specific to general.

twist.text: Speakers inherit properties down the tree: if birds have wings, robins have wings—no need to say it.

climax.text: This hierarchy powers AI knowledge bases and every library classification system.

punchline.text: Meaning flows downhill—from general to specific.

quiz.question: What is a hyponym?
options: A more specific term within a category
